title: Monomial on an extension by positive signs
statement: Let $J$ and $U$ be finite sets of coordinates among $n$, and let $y$ assign a sign to each element of $J$. Extend $y$ to all $n$ coordinates by assigning $+1$ outside $J$. The monomial on $U$ at this extension equals the monomial on the coordinates in $U\cap J$, evaluated using $y$.
hypotheses_covered: $J,U$ are finite sets of coordinates among $n$
